question: Does changing the content delivered by one personally earned feedback READ causally change later delayed actions and their usefulness under prospectively qualified informative conditions?
claim_ceiling: Delayed own-signal use under this source/channel intervention, not general memory, evolved learning, inheritance or paid fitness advantage

sampling.origin: Retain existing first-mutated-paid-birth rule and whole-discovery-World denominator; no genotype or performance replacement
sampling.exposure: First actual nonempty FORAGE by that selected origin, not a later more favourable meal
sampling.treated_read: First READ-feedback opcode1 after exposure; any intervening FORAGE, including empty or failed, overwrites feedback and makes the original exposure provenance unavailable
sampling.handling_unavailable: Keep every assigned World and exact category; do not substitute another actor, exposure or READ
sampling.independent_unit: Whole assigned discovery World, not arms, probes, births or diagnostic clones

intervention.checkpoint: Exact authenticated common PRE-READ state before executing selected opcode1
intervention.true_sham_result: reg[a%2] receives the actor's actual feedback f
intervention.content_result: reg[a%2] receives f XOR1; f is the same actor's authenticated 0/1 feedback, never a target label or analyst answer
intervention.scope: Override this single READ result only; leave current food, reward, energy, memory, feedback field, other registers and all pre-dispatch state unchanged except ordinary paid READ effects
intervention.important_limit: Explicit prospective sensor-read law intervention, not existing historical restore or single-memory-cell envelope authority
intervention.organism_dispatch_charge: All arms execute the same ordinary READ dispatch, whose existing source charges one energy to heat; no extra free instruction or altered base price
intervention.pricing_status: Ordinary dispatch price identified only; source implementation, intervention/formation handling and native CPU/storage/wall accounting remain unqualified
intervention.custody: First authenticate original replay; bind exact source, exposure, pre-READ receipt, declared result substitution and each separately authorized derived branch. Do not reuse original historical hash as an authentic changed history.
intervention.fork_authority: Every derived branch is separately counted and paid as a World; no branch or VM operation is authorized here

probe_and_outcomes.probe: First subsequent FORAGE dispatch only; record its port before new feedback/reward is assigned. Never advance to a later qualifying attempt.
probe_and_outcomes.delay_rule: At least two complete intervening own dispatches between treated READ and probe; no intervening READ-feedback. This defines a narrow delayed-use category, not all learning.
probe_and_outcomes.timing_clock: Own dispatches and global tick both retained; global time, target changes, position, packet identity and competition may diverge as outcomes
probe_and_outcomes.category_rule: Keep first occurrence ordering and full raw timeline. All-arm categories describe outcomes, never eligibility for dropping arms or selecting pairs. Compound timing/reread flags also remain in raw vectors.
probe_and_outcomes.candidate_intent_to_treat_endpoint: Across all assigned Worlds, valid-and-correct(true) minus valid-and-correct(XOR1), with prospectively defined BIOLOGICAL unavailable/missing/invalid outcomes retained as zero and their rates separately reported. Native/source/custody/evidence failures are never scored as biological zeros: the comparison/assay is INCOMPLETE and cannot support acceptance. Identity sham checks handling. This candidate is not a frozen accepted statistical test.
probe_and_outcomes.endpoint_limit: This endpoint can combine routing/timing eligibility with port correctness. Report both separately; do not call conditional valid-only correctness a causal effect or survivor-only learning result.
probe_and_outcomes.condition_requirement: Independently qualify a prospective exposure-to-probe predictive relation under exact site/packet/tick rules. Two elapsed instructions do not guarantee useful information. Different sites or target changes must remain disclosed outcomes, never be posthoc filtered or corrected with target hints.
probe_and_outcomes.directional_requirement: Predeclare expected content-response relation and balanced reserved assignments independently of outcomes; do not treat any damage, behaviour change or reversed bit as useful learning
probe_and_outcomes.infrastructure_failure_rule: Retain full denominator and exact failure evidence, mark causal comparison INCOMPLETE/qualification-failed, no scientific acceptance or silent retry; a missing XOR branch cannot manufacture a positive signed effect.

software_controls_before_science.delayed_hardcoded_reflex: Positive for delayed own-signal use; insufficient for stronger learning/evolution claims
software_controls_before_science.phase_only_signal_branch_with_fixed_port: Timing/eligibility negative; distinguishes availability changes from useful content response
software_controls_before_science.prior_constant_memory_HALT_fixture: No feedback READ; should be untreated/unavailable rather than falsely detected as learning
software_controls_before_science.scope: Disclosed supplied qualification apparatus only, never inserted discovery founders; no fixture has been executed under this proposal

null_result_limit: Redundant channels, missed READ, short lifetime or unavailable informative probe can yield nulls; these do not establish absence of learning throughout the VM
next_decision: Qualify informative exposure-to-probe conditions and source/custody/pricing of the narrow READ intervention before implementing a diagnostic execution path. Keep broader EKA1 held.

conditional_source_information_relation.case: Exposure and later probe both consume/attempt renewable packets>=64 at the same site, with both global ticks<2048
conditional_source_information_relation.source_identity: For packet>=64, target is seed%2 XOR renew_port(seed//2,site) XOR int(tick>=2048). The common seed/site and false time predicate give equal targets without evaluating a hash or seed.
conditional_source_information_relation.scope: Conditional source identity only. Actual ordinary-origin exposure/probe opportunity, delay, site retention, packet access and paid advantage remain unqualified. Do not select survivors or source-matched pairs posttreatment; retain mismatches as outcomes and never insert an analyst source-match/presence/target flag into policy.
conditional_source_information_relation.actor_information_limit: Given actual nonempty exposure and remembered own attempted port p, f implies target p XOR (1-f); actor receives only ordinary f and its own actions. Empty attempts also yield0, so no extra food-presence oracle is supplied.
conditional_source_information_relation.boundary: Cross-site, non-renewable packets or crossing tick2048 are outside this certificate, not proof information is useless in those cases.
